description: 인천국제공항공사_주차 정보 [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천국제공항공사. 인천국제공항공사에서 제공하는 인천국제공항 제 1터미널과 제 2터미널의 주차장에 대한 데이터로 주차장별(단기주차장 지하 1층/지하2층/지상층,장기주차장 P1/P2/P3/P4, 주차타워. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천국제공항공사. Its tags are 인천공항 주차장정보, 인천공항 주차정보, 인천공항 주차시설, 인천공항 주차면수, 인천공항 주차현황시간. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
